comely.definitionKo: 주로 남자가, 체격이 좋거나 얼굴이 깔끔하게 잘생기다.
comely.englishDescription: Usually used for men, being well-built and having a neat and attractive appearance.

gossip.englishDescription: To keep chattering about something to no purpose.

illustration.definitionKo: 어떤 의미나 내용을 시각적으로 전달하기 위해 사용되는 그림이나 사진.
illustration.englishDescription: A picture or photo used to deliver a certain meaning or contents visually.

illustration.definitionKo: 책이나 신문, 잡지 등에서, 내용을 더 잘 이해하게 하도록 넣는 그림.
illustration.englishDescription: A picture inserted into a book, newspaper, magazine, etc., to help readers understand its contents.

porridge.definitionKo: 화나 분통 등의 감정을 참지 못하여 마음속이 부글부글 끓어오르다.
porridge.englishDescription: To seethe inside with surging feelings such as rage, resentment, etc.

porridge.definitionKo: 애써 한 일을 남에게 빼앗기거나, 의도하지 않은 사람에게 이로운 일을 하다.
porridge.englishExpression: cook juk, porridge, and give it to a dog
porridge.englishDescription: For one's achievement to be taken by someone or to do favor for the wrong person.

porridge.englishExpression: be neither juk, porridge, nor rice; come to nothing; be good for nothing
porridge.englishDescription: For something to be done halfway with nothing achieved.
To completely ruin something or fail.

porridge.englishExpression: regardless of whether something becomes juk, porridge, or rice
porridge.englishDescription: No matter what; regardless of whether something will suceed or not.

score.definitionKo: 축구, 농구, 하키, 핸드볼 등의 경기에서 공을 넣어 점수를 얻는 일. 또는 그 얻은 점수.
score.englishDescription: An act of scoring with a ball in games such as soccer, basketball, hockey, handball, etc.; or the ball scoring a goal.

score.definitionKo: 농구나 탁구 등의 운동 경기에 점수를 얻음. 또는 그 점수.
score.englishDescription: An act of scoring a point in such a sport game as basketball, table tennis, etc., or such a score.

wine.definitionKo: 포도의 즙을 발효시켜서 만든 서양 술.
wine.englishDescription: Western liquor made by fermenting the juice of grapes.
